summary.note: Preregistered gate rs1 FAILED: mixed_reversals=44/200 seeds, p=1.0 (not < 0.01). rs2 correctly held (control_reversals=40/200, p=1.0, not significant). replay PASSED. Both mixed and control conditions show the population mean behavior_exploration declining monotonically across all three regime segments (scarcity->abundance->scarcity) in the large majority of seeds, rather than tracking the pressure reversal -- and this pattern appears almost identically in the no-standing-variation control, which had no allele composition to select on. This is most consistent with a mutation-boundary clamping artifact (Gaussian mutation near the locus lower bound of 0.0 is asymmetrically truncated, pulling the population mean toward 0 over many generations regardless of regime) rather than genuine selection tracking the pressure schedule. See the audit doc methods section. This is a real negative finding for reversible selection on standing variation under this design, reported as observed, not adjusted after the fact.
